newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Ceval Q1 profit vs loss.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Ceval Q1 profit vs loss.

text.p: Brazilian soybean and food firm Ceval Alimentos released the following first-quarter 1997 results.
NOTE: Figures in U.S. dollars, adjusted for inflation.
The company, one of the top players in the world grains market, said net sales were up 4.8 percent from 1996 Q1.

Ceval said industrial products accounted for 42.5 percent of 1997 Q1 gross sales, or $229.4 million, consumer products made up 43.7 percent, or $236 million, and meats comprised 13.8 percent, or $74.3 million.
Sales costs dropped 12.4 percent from 1996 Q1.
Consolidated gross margin rose to 19.1 percent from 16.9 percent a year earlier due to a hike in world soybean prices and the outlook for a slight increase local soy prices in the 1996-1997 harvest.
Administrative expenses fell to 4.7 percent of net sales from 6.5 percent.
